Hello! This is my first time using skeb, and I quite like your art! I would like to request a movie of my character Sheila, and my friend's character Goomy, to be together. Sheila on the left, and Goomy on the right, please. The two of them should be holding mojito cocktails, and the animation can be them clinking the glasses together. Sheila and Goomy should look cheerful, and a little drunk! If you can include a heart above them, that would be nice! Thank you, I hope what I've requested is acceptable!
